selection_origin.rule: The input-only case and ten fixed seeds were frozen before the V5 formal results. V7 changes only an acceptance-ledger bug and therefore reuses that result-blind case without reading any V7 outcome.

selection_boundary: The 100-customer case is used only to display the search process. It is not claimed to statistically represent all 81 instances. Generality must come from the complete 81-instance matrix.

trajectory_contract.source: actual online complete-model checkpoint observations plus the returned endpoint
trajectory_contract.display_seed_rule: For each algorithm, choose the seed whose final cost is closest to that algorithm's ten-seed mean; break an exact tie by smaller seed.
trajectory_contract.axes: same time(min)-cost(CNY) single-axis convention as Chen et al. (2025)
forbidden: changing the instance or seed after seeing curve shape
offline scoring of discarded candidates that the algorithm did not retain as online complete checkpoints
